 Black Friday deals are landing all around us this weekend, as retailers like Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and GameStop drop their PS5, Switch 2, Xbox, and PC discounts a week ahead of schedule.
 The main event remains November 27, but stores are already in full Black Friday deals mode right now. Amazon has new record-low prices on some of our favorite tech and accessories, Best Buy is joining it with some of the best PS5 game deals we've seen this year, and Walmart's matching both of them on some of this year's heavy hitters.
 We've still got a week to go before official Black Friday deals grace our shelves. Having covered this particular event for years now, though, there are a few offers I trust enough to jump in early. Retailers rotate through their offers in the lead up to the big day, and often we see the very same discounts return right at the end of the month.
 These top picks are just below, but I'm running through all the biggest early Black Friday deals to find you more today.
 Tabitha Baker 
Social Links Navigation
 Managing Editor - Hardware 
 I've been tracking Black Friday deals for over seven years now, tracing timelines and watching prices rise and fall in the lead up to the year's biggest sales event. I'm also watching those prices across the rest of the year, though, while going hands-on with the tech set to hit the hardest when discounts launch. That means I know which PS5, Switch, Xbox and PC gadgets are actually worth your time and how much you should be paying for them this November.

 Remember, Nintendo drops its Black Friday deals on Sunday
 (Image credit: Future) 
 Here's what you're looking for:
 The Nintendo Switch 2 will come with a free copy of Mario Kart World and a three month Nintendo Switch Online Individual membership. That's a bumper pack for the $499 we usually see on the console, and it looks like other retailers will be getting in on this one as well. For now, keep the existing Mario Kart World bundle listing handy to get there straight away on day one:
 Mario Kart World Nintendo Switch 2 bundle | $549.99 at Amazon 
 Then we're onto games. So far, we only know of six physical titles definitely included in the sale. Each one is set to receive a $20 discount, which looks a little like this:
 Donkey Kong Bananza ($49.99) at Amazon 
 Kirby Air Riders ($39.99) at Amazon 
 Metroid Prime 4 Beyond ($39.99) at Amazon 
 Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 ($49.99) at Amazon 
 Super Mario Party Jamboree NS2 ($59.99) at Amazon 
 Keep those links handy on Sunday!
 2026-11-20T17:01:50.350Z 
 A retro mobile controller at its lowest price yet
 (Image credit: Phil Hayton) 
 The GameSir Pocket Taco is down to its lowest price yet in Amazon's Black Friday deals. That's a 26% discount on the $34.99 MSRP, dropping us off at $25.99. That's a solid offer considering it's the first time we've seen it this far down the $20s scale.
 The Bluetooth clackers are best suited to Game Boy and Game Boy Advance titles, but run on both Android and iOS, with a satisfying, low-weight approach to on-the-go emulation.
 GameSir Pocket Taco | $34.99 $25.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best mobile controllers 
 Read more: GameSir Pocket Taco review 
 2026-11-20T16:25:42.774Z 
 Hunting down Legend of Zelda Switch 2 stock?
 (Image credit: Future) 
 So are we!
 Anyone on the hunt for Legend of Zelda Switch 2 restocks will have been disappointed this week. We've only spotted a few very brief flashes of availability on the 40th Edition handheld.
 Thankfully, we're expecting that to change as we get closer to Black Friday. Retailers often hold back this hard-to-find stock ahead of the sale event, hoping to use it to lure shoppers to their sites when the discounts are heating up. We saw it with PS5, Xbox Series X, previous anniversary releases, and I'm pretty sure we're seeing with the latest Ninty handheld.
 2026-11-20T16:06:09.919Z 
 A record-low on a game with slightly too many nouns in the title
 (Image credit: Focus Entertainment) 
 Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy might be one of the wordier titles in 2026, but it's still 33% off at Amazon all the same. If you've been with the Plague Tale series since the start, this is an excellent opportunity to grab the latest instalment for its best price yet - shaving that $59.99 MSRP down to $39.99 this weekend.
 This is only the second time we've seen the title skim its launch price, having only dropped to $50 in one sale before today (and even that was at the end of October). We gave it 4.5/5 stars at review, and don't worry - you don't need to have played the originals to get a sense of what's going on here.
 Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy | $59.99 $39.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best games of 2026 
 Read more: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy review 
 2026-11-20T15:41:48.010Z 
 PSA: Make sure you've got the right filters on for Walmart
 (Image credit: Walmart) 
 Walmart allows third party marketplace sellers onto its platform to sell alongside the retailer itself. That's all fine and dandy if it's a trusted store (Antonline, Newegg, and other retailers can be regularly found on these shelves). However, it's always worth checking your seller before heading to checkout - especially if a price looks too good to be true. Bad eggs do exist here.
 To play it safe, I generally recommend scrolling down to the bottom of the left navigation meu and selecting 'Walmart' from the list of displayed retailers. That way you'll only see the Black Friday deals from the store itself.
 2026-11-20T15:21:04.226Z 
 The budget PS5 headset to watch this weekend
 (Image credit: Future/Rosalie Newcombe) 
 The Turtle Beach Atlas 200 has been baiting us all week. This is our go-to budget PS5 headset, even at its full $59.99 price. However, it's been on sale for around $35 for as long as I can remember. That all changed as soon as Black Friday got close, though.
 The wired headset has been up at its full price for a little while now, and didn't even drop back to $34.99 when Amazon launched its first roster of Black Friday deals yesterday. Don't give up on it yet, though. Given how frequently it's been on sale throughout the year, it's highly likely we'll see the return of that record-low in the near-future, potentially with an extra saving tacked on.
 Turtle Beach Atlas Air 200 | $59.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best PS5 headset 
 Read more: Turtle Beach Atlas 200 review 
 2026-11-20T15:00:42.313Z 
 Amazon is reserving some offers for Prime members
 (Image credit: Future) 
 I haven't seen too many instances, but it looks like some of Amazon's Black Friday deals are reserved for Prime members only. Thankfully, so far there's no headline-grabbers on this exclusive list - the closest I've seen sits on the Switch 2 grip case I use every day.
 The Supcase model is down 16% for Amazon's subscribers, but we've still got a few bucks to go before a record-low. If you're not a member, you're not missing out on too much here - I'd still recommend waiting until this one's at around $20 before diving straight in.
 Supcase Switch 2 grip case | $29.99 $25.19 at Amazon 
 Read more: Supcase Unicorn Beetle Pro review 
 2026-11-20T14:40:17.677Z 
 One for the OG Switch owners
 (Image credit: Future / Duncan Robertson) 
 The CRKD Nitro Deck Plus is on sale for Black Friday, but it's worth noting this is only for those with the original Switch or Switch OLED . The newer Nitro Deck 2 is designed for Ninty's latest handheld.
 Still, if you're sticking it out with the OG it's well worth heading over to Woot this weekend. The Renegade Raider Fortnite Edition is down to a record-low $34.99 on the Amazon-owned site, a brand new record-low over the previous $44.99.
 If the design's a bit loud you'll need to stick at that previous record. Amazon has the 18% discount live on the shelves right now, in a more subdued black or transparent colorway.
 The CRKD Nitro Deck Plus keeps the handheld fully dockable, adding Hall effect sticks, back buttons, and full customization via the CRKD app. We scored it 4.5/5 stars when we reviewed it a few years back, loving its symmetrical sticks and additional controls but a little dissuaded by the cheaper plastic feel.
 CRKD Nitro Deck Plus | $69.99 $34.99 at Woot 
 CRKD Nitro Deck Plus | $69.99 $44.99 at Amazon 
 Read more: CRKD Nitro Deck Plus review 
 2026-11-20T14:20:49.758Z 
 The best Hall effect keyboard I've used so far, at its lowest price yet
 (Image credit: Future) 
 The Asus ROG Azoth is one of my favorite gaming keyboard lines. It looks, feels, and plays beautifully, while doing a lot more than its competitors (Corsair) with that display in the top right corner.
 Asus keyboards are expensive, though, often falling short in their numbers compared to the rest of the market. That's where Black Friday shines brightest.
 The Asus ROG Azoth 96 HE is the most comfortable, adjustable, and satisfying magnetic keyboard I've had on my desk so far, but it's usually found at a hefty $359.99. Amazon has it down to $234.99 for the first time ever this weekend - impressive considering this one hasn't even neared $250 in previous sales.
 Asus ROG Azoth 96 HE | $359.99 $234.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best Hall effect keyboard 
 Read more: Asus ROG Azoth 96 HE review 
 2026-11-20T13:58:38.050Z 
 That Ocarina of Time discount is certainly holding out nicely
 (Image credit: Nintendo) 
 Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is the Switch 2 game on everyone's lips at the moment, and it's only just hit the shelves at the start of the month. Being such a big release, and coming first party from Nintendo, I wasn't expecting to see any savings here this Black Friday.
 That all changed earlier in the week, when the digital edition shed $5 from its $59.99 MSRP at Amazon. The physical edition has been on sale before, with it own $69.99 starting price dropping to $59.99 during the pre-order phase. That offer's out, though, and we're at a record-low price this weekend - if you're happy to sacrifice that case and cart.
 The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (digital) | $59.99 $54.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best Switch 2 games 
 Read more: Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake review 
 2026-11-20T13:40:22.480Z 
 The headset for budget-minded deal hunters
 (Image credit: Future/Rosalie Newcombe) 
 The Turtle Beach Airlite Fit is our go-to recommendation for anyone who simply can't stand TV speakers (or their families who simply can't stand video game soundtracks).
 There's a surprising power behind these super cheap cups, one we wouldn't have expected from a sub-$30 headset just a few years ago. The wired connection keeps things simple as well, plugging directly into your Switch or controller without requiring charging.
 The Airlite Fit is usually an easy recommendation when it (regularly) drops to $17.99. Amazon's done one better in its Black Friday deals this weekend, though, with a new record-low $14.99 position.
 Turtle Beach Airlite Fit | $27.99 $14.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best gaming headset 
 Read more: Turtle Beach Airlite Fit review 
 2026-11-20T13:22:28.507Z 
 Top Tip: Price check
 (Image credit: Nintendo) 
 Even a week out from Black Friday itself, retailers' early deals are already incredibly competitive. While we're seeing major stores like Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart price-matching one another on the real heavy-hitters, there are still moments where one can undercut another.
 That's why it's always important to price check your deals of choice. Some stores can sneak in extra discounts via coupon codes, gift cards, or bonus subscriptions - even if their on-page prices are the same. Things move fast in this sale, so always do you research before heading to checkout.
 2026-11-20T12:57:45.870Z 
 Our top PS5 headset is still at its best price yet
 (Image credit: Future/Rosalie Newcombe) 
 While some of Amazon's biggest offers are already starting to filter off the shelves, more premium hardware is still holding steady. Take our top-rated gaming headset.
 The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni brings the hot-swappable batteries and simultaneous 2.4GHz and Bluetooth audio over from the equally lauded Pro Wireless model, boosting that pedigree audio with Hi-Res certifications in tow as well. It's only ever dropped to $359.99 in previous (rare) sales, but Amazon's Black Friday deals have it down to $349.99 this weekend. That's a new record-low by $10.
 SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni | $399.99 $349.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best PS5 headsets 
 Read more: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Omni review 
 2026-11-20T12:45:06.838Z 
 Only one of our top gaming chairs is seeing a major discount so far this Black Friday
 (Image credit: Future / Duncan Robertson) 
 The AutoFull G7 is the only gaming chair in our top picks seeing a new record-low price this Black Friday. The $569.99 mesh chair has dropped to $455.99 for the first time this weekend, having previously only hit at around $480 in previous offers. This one's been locked at over $500 for most of the year.
 The G7 is super adjustable and boasts one of the best lumbar support systems we've tested so far. That breathable material prevents longer sessions from overheating, but actually manages to stay comfortable under the buns (something you can't take for granted across the rest of the market).
 Autofull G7 | $569.99 $455.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best gaming chairs 
 Read more: Autofull G7 review 
 2026-11-20T12:31:26.800Z 
 This might have been the best Switch 2 controller deal of Black Friday, and it's already sold out
 (Image credit: Future) 
 Well I wasn't expecting that yet.
 The GameSir Super Nova returns to this week's $29.99 Black Friday price pretty regularly, but it's still the best budget Switch 2 controller deal on the shelves when it appears. For just $30 you're getting a wireless gamepad with trigger stops, a charging dock, premium build materials, and super comfortable controls. That's a value-busting feature set at this price point, something few other gamepads can compete with at all.
 After flying high yesterday, Best Buy (the only retailer with this price) has run out of stock on this, one of my absolute go-to offers. It's still worth hitting that notification bell, though, this one could storm back into action when the heat is on next week.
 GameSir Super Nova | Check stock at Best Buy 
 Featured in: Best Nintendo Switch 2 controllers 
 Read more: GameSir Super Nova review 
 2026-11-20T12:15:42.042Z 
 One of my go-to Switch 2 accessories just appeared at Amazon for the first time
 (Image credit: Future) 
 Very suspicious.
 The Genki Covert Dock 3 is a ride-or-die for my Switch 2, a fully fledged Switch 2 dock with the footprint of a regular power adapter. The thing is, this gadget's only ever been available at Genki's own site in the past. Well, it's popped up at Amazon today - just in time for some savings?
 Not quite yet. The 65W charger / HDMI connection is still at its usual $69.99 MSRP, but previous generation iterations of this device have been firm Black Friday favorites. It hasn't seen a single price cut in its life so far, but this is one I'd be watching with a keen eye next week.
 Genki Covert Dock 3 | $69.99 at Amazon 
 Read more: Genki Covert Dock 3 review 
 2026-11-20T12:00:29.467Z 
 PSA: Silent Hill Townfall was $29.99 briefly yesterday
 (Image credit: Konami) 
 The latest Konami spook (now $49.94 at Amazon) took a brief stroll down to $29.99 yesterday. That was a real flash, though, the retailer promptly raised the price just an hour after I first spotted the saving. I'd be wary of jumping in too early on this 2026 release, then - it looks like there's still wiggle room on those final figures before Black Friday is out.
 Silent Hill: Townfall | $49.94 (aiming for $29.99) at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best games of 2026 
 Read more: Silent Hill: Townfall review 
 2026-11-20T11:44:48.977Z 
 DualSense special editions are starting to sell out already
 (Image credit: Phil Hayton) 
 The PS5 DualSense controller is still at its lowest $54 price of the year, but it's not just the stock black and white model on sale ahead of Black Friday. You'll find everything from camo to Chroma editions also on sale for $20 off this weekend.
 Some are moving fast, though. Right now Amazon has run out of stock on some of the more vibrant colorways, including Cobalt Blue and Techno Red. However, there are still plenty of options out there while supplies hold out a little longer.
 It's worth noting the newer Prism options aren't included in this sale, and neither's the GTA 6 special edition.
 See all DualSense options at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best PS5 controller 
 Read more: DualSense review 
 2026-11-20T11:25:08.646Z 
 This is the Switch 2 bundle we're waiting for
 (Image credit: Future/Rosalie Newcombe) 
 Nintendo won't launch its Black Friday deals until Sunday November 22, but when they do roll around it's going to be the Mario Kart World bundle at center stage.
 The package usually goes for $549.99, adding the handheld's new $499 MSRP and shaving a little off the $79.99 game (while also throwing in a Switch Online Individual membership). Come Sunday, you'll be paying the same $499.99 you would for the console itself, getting Mario Kart World for free.
 Nintendo announced its offers last week, and it looks like other retailers will also be shipping the discounted bundle. Keep an eye on Amazon this weekend for the biggest Switch 2 deal since those prices went up, then.
 Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle | $549.99 at Amazon 
 Featured in: Best gaming handhelds 
 Read more: Nintendo Switch 2 review 
 2026-11-20T11:10:06.205Z 
 Lego Horizon Adventures has already sold out on Switch at Best Buy
 (Image credit: Sony) 
 Lego Horizon Adventures is down to $9.99 across the web for Black Friday, in both its PS5 and Switch outings.
